title: Queue Fabric is execution truth; APIs are edge adapters
summary: VMM execution uses durable queue-persistable commands/events and asynchronous lifecycle truth. A routed order is not a synchronous function result; venue acknowledgement, fill, cancellation and reconciliation are facts that arrive later.
invariants: Canonical external execution protocol is vmm.execution/0.4.
JSON/HTTP may translate edge messages but cannot mutate VMM inventory or manufacture fill truth.
A routed cancel becomes CANCEL_PENDING until venue confirmation; it is not fabricated as CANCELLED.
UNKNOWN_PENDING_RECONCILIATION is an explicit state; timeout is not evidence of failure.
Venue fills are post-trade facts and must be booked even if a strategy is later disabled or risk limits changed.

provenance.claim: Queue-persisted execution payloads, asynchronous lifecycle, cancel/reconcile semantics and JSON edge rule.
